key_insight: Precision-aware PTME profiling shows that lightweight LLM deployment choices cannot be made reliably from size or FLOPs alone because resource cost and task accuracy do not track each other.
engineering_relevance: For edge and local deployment, PTME measurements help engineers pick models that meet accuracy targets while minimizing real hardware costs in time, memory, and energy.
method: Measure Precision, Time, peak Memory, and Energy directly on hardware during inference.
Test multiple lightweight LLMs under controlled edge-class resource envelopes.
Use Pareto analysis to identify non-dominated model configurations across PTME trade-offs.
evidence_signal: The paper evaluates lightweight LLMs locally on a desktop platform across benchmarks for code generation, mathematical reasoning, and multi-task understanding, comparing direct PTME measurements against proxy descriptors.
watch_item: Results are tied to a controlled desktop setup, so deployment rankings may shift on other devices, workloads, or thermal/power constraints.
